tests.name: Effective description
tests.reasoning: The description uses imperative phrasing ('Use for AWS Systems Manager Automation tasks. Find an AWS-owned or account-owned runbook for...'), focuses on user intent/goals (finding a runbook, preparing a safe start, explaining failures, reviewing for security problems) rather than internal implementation, and lists several explicit trigger contexts (unreachable EC2 instance, missing node, public S3 bucket, Config finding, execution failures/cancellations/approvals, security review). It is concise, fitting in a short paragraph.
tests.evidence: Use for AWS Systems Manager Automation tasks. Find an AWS-owned or account-owned runbook for an operational problem such as an unreachable EC2 instance, a node missing from Systems Manager, a public S3 bucket or a Config finding; prepare a safe start with rate control and a stopping alarm; explain why an execution failed, was cancelled or is waiting for approval; or review a runbook for security problems.
